meta.name: ops-inspector
meta.description: AIOps-style one-click inspection skill for CloudBase resources. Use this skill when users need to diagnose errors, check resource health, inspect logs, or run a comprehensive health check across cloud functions, CloudRun services, databases, and other CloudBase resources.

copy.tagline: 一键巡检云资源健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理腾讯云CloudBase资源需要快速诊断和健康检查。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage CloudBase resources and need quick diagnostics and health checks.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会变成CloudBase资源的巡检助手。当你要求检查资源健康或诊断错误时，它会自动检查环境、日志服务、云函数、CloudRun等，最后生成一份带有严重等级和操作建议的巡检报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“巡检”、“诊断”、“health check”、“inspection”等关键词，或者要求检查CloudBase资源健康、排查错误时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下我的CloudBase环境整体健康状况。
say.note: Claude会执行全面巡检，生成报告。

say.text: 最近云函数出现了超时错误，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: Claude会针对云函数做定向检查并分析日志。

say.text: 检查一下CloudRun服务有没有什么问题。
say.note: Claude会检查CloudRun服务的状态和错误。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude becomes a CloudBase resource inspector. When you ask to check resource health or diagnose errors, it automatically inspects environment, log service, cloud functions, CloudRun, etc., and generates a structured report with severity levels and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'inspection', 'health check', 'diagnosis', 'troubleshooting', or ask to check CloudBase resource health or debug errors.

say_en.text: Check the overall health of my CloudBase environment.
say_en.note: Claude will run a full inspection and generate a report.

say_en.text: Cloud functions are timing out recently, please diagnose.
say_en.note: Claude will do a targeted check on cloud functions and analyze logs.

say_en.text: Check if there are any issues with CloudRun services.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect CloudRun service status and errors.
